# Techlabs gallery backend

> A small FastAPI control plane that gates the static Techlabs gallery behind
> Microsoft Entra ID, records who deploys which use case, provisions Azure
> resources directly with its managed identity, and tears them down on a
> schedule. A single SQLite file on App Service's persistent `/home` share is the
> system of record.

## Modules

- [app.py](app.py): FastAPI app — serves the static gallery, runs the Entra OAuth gate, starts the cleanup scheduler.
- [entra_auth.py](entra_auth.py): Entra ID OAuth (PKCE) sign-in flow and the in-memory session store.
- [identity.py](identity.py): Resolves the caller's identity + role for `/api/*` routes; fails closed.
- [api.py](api.py): `/api/*` JSON endpoints (deployments, users, telemetry).
- [db.py](db.py): All persistence — SQLite schema plus every read/write helper.
- [azure_deploy.py](azure_deploy.py): In-process executor that provisions/destroys Azure resources with the app's managed identity; branches on the deployment `engine`. After a successful deploy it grants the signed-in user Reader on their resource group (best-effort, RG-scoped) so they can view it in the portal; cross-tenant users are first invited as a B2B guest (Microsoft Graph).
- [terraform_exec.py](terraform_exec.py): Terraform engine — runs a use case's Terraform module (`_tf/<use_case>/`) with the managed identity (azurerm + `ARM_USE_MSI`) instead of submitting ARM JSON.
- [terraform_bootstrap.py](terraform_bootstrap.py): Opt-in, best-effort provisioning of the `terraform` binary into the persistent `/home` share on startup (pinned release, SHA256-verified).
- [scheduler.py](scheduler.py): Background asyncio task that tears down deployments past their end time.

## Database

- One SQLite file, opened once per process, WAL journaling, guarded by a process-wide lock; the app runs a single gunicorn worker so one writer is always sufficient.
- Location resolved by `db._default_db_path()`: `GALLERY_DB_PATH` env → `/home/data/techlabs.db` (persistent Azure Files, survives restarts/redeploys) → `site/server/data/techlabs.db` (local fallback).
- Persistent: user identities, roles, deployment records, telemetry. Not persistent: the in-memory OAuth session (users re-sign-in after a restart; identity and admin role are restored from the DB).

## Schema (see SCHEMA in db.py)

- `users`: one row per signed-in user. `oid` (Entra object ID) PK, `upn`, `name`, `role` ('admin'|'guest'), `created_at`, `last_seen`. First-ever sign-in is bootstrapped to `admin`. Admin pre-assignments are placeholder rows keyed `upn:<upn>` and reconciled on first sign-in.
- `deployments`: one row per provisioning request. `id` PK, `use_case`, `environment`, `engine` ('bicep'|'terraform'), `user_oid`/`user_upn`/`user_name`, `subscription_id`, `resource_group`, `status` (requested|deploying|active|expiring|destroying|destroyed|failed), `created_at`, `end_at`, `destroyed_at`, `gh_run_url`, `detail`, `params_json`. Indexed by user, status, end_at.
- `events`: append-only telemetry. `id` PK, `ts`, `type` (view|signin|deploy_requested|deploy_succeeded|cleanup_triggered|…), `user_oid`/`user_upn`, `use_case`, `deployment_id`, `meta_json`. Indexed by ts, type, user.

## Access helpers (db.py)

- Users/roles: `upsert_user`, `get_role`, `list_users`, `set_user_role`, `has_admin`.
- Deployments: `create_deployment`, `update_deployment`, `get_deployment`, `list_deployments`, `due_deployments`.
- Telemetry: `record_event`, `telemetry_summary`.

## Why SQLite

- Internal tool with modest write volume; zero infrastructure and zero database cost.
- A single gunicorn worker is required anyway (in-memory sessions), so there is no multi-writer problem.
- Persistent and portable: sits on the App Service `/home` share, backs up with the app, copyable for inspection.

## Configuration

- See [.env.example](.env.example): `GALLERY_ENTRA_TENANT_ID`, `GALLERY_ENTRA_CLIENT_ID`, `GALLERY_SUBSCRIPTION_ID`, `GALLERY_DEPLOY_LOCATION`, `GALLERY_HTTPS`, `GALLERY_CLEANUP_INTERVAL_SECONDS`, `GALLERY_DB_PATH`.
- Deployment engines: every use case ships both a Bicep and a Terraform module. Bicep needs no extra config. In-app Terraform deploys are capability-gated (`GET /api/me` -> `terraformExecAvailable`) and the deploy modal always shows the Terraform CLI snippet, so leaving Terraform unconfigured is safe. To enable in-app Terraform on App Service set app settings `GALLERY_TERRAFORM_AUTO_INSTALL=true` (or pre-stage `GALLERY_TERRAFORM_BIN`), `ARM_USE_MSI=true`, `ARM_SUBSCRIPTION_ID`, `ARM_TENANT_ID`. Local state on `/home` needs no new role (same MI that deploys Bicep); an azurerm remote backend (`GALLERY_TF_STATE_STORAGE`) needs Storage Blob Data Contributor on the state account.

## Run locally

- `cd site/server; pip install -r requirements.txt; uvicorn app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000` then browse http://localhost:8000/ and sign in.
